llm_response.reason: The website exhibits multiple scam characteristics: (1) Unusually large and diverse product range similar to scam aggregators, (2) Urgency and exclusivity language targeting psychological weaknesses, (3) Promises of top rankings and exclusive benefits/freeshipping, (4) The use of a residential address and a generic, unrelated email address that does not match business standards, (5) Vague privacy/customer information policies, (6) No hyperlinks for navigation or verification, (7) No evidence of a legitimate business or company information, and (8) Vague mention of refund/payment with ambiguous methods and text. These red flags are consistent with Fake Online Shopping scams.
